guarantees.claim: tx_out_q is updated on posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni: if !rst_ni, assigned 1'b1; else if ovrd_tx_en, assigned ovrd_tx_val; else if sys_loopback, assigned 1'b1; else assigned tx_out.

assumptions.claim: Inputs tx_out, ovrd_tx_en, ovrd_tx_val, and sys_loopback must be synchronous to clk_i and meet setup/hold at its rising edge.
assumptions.cond: while clk_i is running and rst_ni is high
assumptions.risk: Metastability or incorrect latch could cause tx_out_q to hold wrong value, leading to UART output errors, loopback failure, or override glitch.

uncertain_points.claim: ovrd_tx_en overrides sys_loopback; if ovrd_tx_en is asserted while sys_loopback is active, tx_out_q outputs ovrd_tx_val instead of forced high, potentially breaking loopback test or normal UART operation.
uncertain_points.risk: Loopback test may fail or produce unexpected data if override is unintentionally enabled; UART output may corrupt under loopback mode.
